scope: Actual unchanged CMSIS queue wrappers/IRQ predicate;24-byte attributes,80-byte static threshold,32-bit product wrap, ignored names/bits/priority, task/ISR routing, zero/nonzero timeout, status and wake-yield, capacity/count and NULLs
limitations: Kernel queue constructors/send/receive/query and scheduler-state boundaries are fixtures. IRQ/mask registers and ICSR are emulator inputs. No composed queue/scheduler graph, physical interrupts or image instruction identity proof.
